purpose: Locally frozen fractional multipath comparison; no outcome-based date or policy selection
geant_source_rule: Require nonempty native DEMANDS sections for every replay bin and initial lookback; reject rather than replace dates if this fails

planner.forecast: Original model forecast plus original validation margin; per-OD maximum over three horizons forms the planning envelope
planner.lp_stage_1: Minimize maximum offered link utilization, conserving 100% of each OD over candidate paths
planner.carbon_stage_2: Minimize mean forecast offered demand times path carbon, under peak <= max(0.8, minimum achievable envelope peak)
planner.te_baseline: Retain minimum achievable envelope peak without the 0.8 carbon slack; minimize changes
planner.lp_last_stage: Minimize L1 change in path fractions within fixed previous objectives, with numerical tolerances only
planner.quantized_variant: Largest-remainder rounding to 100 buckets per OD; post-rounding guard violations reported
planner.realized_allocation: Equal-rate max-min service across OD aggregates under the committed fractional link incidence; subpaths gain no extra fairness shares

transforms: Same reference training-only pair selection, scaling, normalizer, candidate paths and assumed capacities for all methods
carbon: GEANT daily 2022 seasonal pairing; Abilene fixed annual EPA 2004 regional rates
interpretation: Aggregate fractional simulation, no packet-ordering or switch deployment claim. One existing neural seed, seven adjacent days per network, modeled capacities and forwarding proxy. Previous study periods remain inspected; these dates have no recorded earlier routing outcomes.
